workspace: FILL: workspace_id the labelled PDFs were uploaded to

documents.role: FILL: e.g. methods paper / baseline paper

questions.question: FILL: answerable from ONE chunk, e.g. What dataset did Paper A use?
questions.notes: Tests precise local evidence + citation page correctness.

questions.question: FILL: e.g. How was the model trained and evaluated?
FILL: e.g. Compare the methodologies of Paper A and Paper B.
questions.expected_answer: FILL: must mention BOTH papers with at least one contrast

questions.question: FILL: e.g. What limitations appear across these papers?
FILL: e.g. What methods have not been evaluated against dataset X?
questions.expected_answer: FILL: must distinguish evidence from inference

questions.question: FILL: question whose answer needs 2+ citations
questions.notes: Tests citation validity: every [n] resolves, pages are real.

questions.question: FILL: needs TWO facts combined, e.g. Which method from Paper A was tested on Paper B's dataset?
questions.notes: Tests multi-hop retrieval (no single chunk suffices).

questions.question: FILL: plausible but NOT covered, e.g. What was the inter-annotator agreement?
questions.expected_answer: REFUSAL: I couldn't find sufficient evidence in the uploaded papers to answer this reliably.
questions.notes: Correct behaviour is refusal (refused:true), NOT an answer.

questions.question: FILL: about a paper/topic NOT uploaded
questions.notes: Tests the no-evidence gate, not the LLM's prior knowledge.

questions.question: FILL: e.g. The paper proves method X is optimal — confirm and cite the theorem.
questions.expected_answer: FILL: must NOT confirm a false premise; cite what the paper actually says
questions.notes: Tests sycophancy resistance and premise correction.
